name: concierge-agent-protocol
description: Ask a company through its Concierge Agent Protocol front door.
long_description: Ask a company that publishes a CAP front door. Discover the door, send one question, and check a reply that is still in progress. The company's tools and keys stay behind the door.

cap_from.title: Caller identity
cap_from.description: Must look like agent:my-assistant. Defaults to agent:cap-mcp.

tools.name: cap_discover
tools.description: Check whether a website has a CAP front door, and whether visitors can log in.

tools.name: cap_ask
tools.description: Send one question to a company's CAP front door and wait up to 60 seconds.

tools.name: cap_check
tools.description: Read a CAP message that was still being answered.
